In the past three decades, nearly 300 people have flown to and from the International Space Station, some of them residing there for months at a time. Over the past several years, the rocket startup Blue Origin launched a series of day trips just over the threshold into space -- high-end carnival rides for celebrities including Katy Perry, Gayle King and William Shatner.The Artemis II lunar mission was different.NASA's spaceflight, which splashed back down Friday evening, carried four astronauts on a round trip all the way to the moon and beyond -- a thousand times farther away than the space station -- and they had to break free from Earth's gravity to do so. It's a trip that only two dozen humans before them had ever taken, and the last time it happened was in 1972.Artemis II's Orion spacecraft also took its four astronauts farther than any humans had ever traveled into space, on a long arc reaching a record 252,756 miles from Earth, giving them a full view of the far side of the moon. By contrast, the Apollo astronauts 50-plus years ago were snuggled into a lunar orbit just 70 or so miles from the surface.This was a massive achievement for NASA in its own right. (NASDAQ: AMZN) stands at a pivotal crossroads, undergoing what CEO Andy Jassy describes as the most significant "reinvention" since the company’s inception. Once defined primarily as an e-commerce pioneer that expanded into the cloud, Amazon has spent the last two years aggressively repositioning itself as a global leader in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure and satellite-based connectivity. The company is currently under the spotlight due to its unprecedented $200 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026—the largest in corporate history. This massive bet on the future of compute and global internet access comes at a time when the company’s core AWS business is re-accelerating, while its retail arm faces intensifying competition from low-cost international challengers and domestic retail giants. Historical Background Founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos in a Bellevue, Washington garage, Amazon’s journey began as an online bookstore. Its early years were defined by the "Get Big Fast" mantra, surviving the dot-com bubble to become a "store for everything." The 2005 launch of Amazon Prime revolutionized consumer expectations for delivery speed and loyalty. However, the company’s most transformative pivot occurred in 2006 with the launch of Amazon Web Services (AWS). Originally an internal project to manage infrastructure, AWS became the backbone of the modern internet and Amazon’s primary profit engine. In 2021, Andy Jassy transitioned from the head of AWS to CEO of the entire corporation, steering the company through the post-pandemic supply chain crisis and the subsequent generative AI boom that reshaped the technology landscape between 2023 and 2025. Business Model Amazon’s business model is a multi-layered ecosystem of services and products that feed into a massive "flywheel" effect: Cloud Computing (AWS): The industry leader in IaaS and PaaS, providing storage, compute, and AI tools to millions of customers. Online and Physical Stores: 1st-party retail and a vast 3rd-party marketplace, complemented by Whole Foods Market and Amazon Fresh. Advertising Services: A high-margin segment leveraging consumer purchase data to sell targeted ads across the Amazon store and Prime Video. Subscription Services: Primarily Amazon Prime, which includes shipping benefits, Prime Video, and Amazon Music. Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper): A burgeoning satellite internet service designed to compete with Starlink and provide global broadband. Custom Silicon: An expanding hardware business producing proprietary chips (Graviton, Trainium, and Inferentia) to reduce reliance on third-party vendors. (AP) — Brian Gay finally figured out how to play the par 5s at The Concession Golf Club, making up ground with an eagle-birdie finish for a 4-under 68 to share the 36-hole lead with Scott Hend of Australia in the Senior PGA Championship on Friday.Hend had five birdies over the last eight holes for a 65, a far more conventional round of eight birdies against only one dropped shot.They were at 10-under 134, two shots ahead of major champions Stewart Cink (67) and Retief Goosen (69), with Ben Crane making his senior debut with a 69 to join them.But it was quite the adventure for Gay. He fanned a 5-iron into the bushes on the par-5 13th after starting the second round on the back nine of Concession. But he got his reward with an eagle on the par-5 eighth and closed with a birdie.“Another pretty good day. A little volatile,” Gay said. “Pretty similar to yesterday, except I butchered a couple of par 5s. Two of them with one bad tee ball, two good tee balls, but other than that, I putted well again. Just a couple of balls in the bushes.”Hend knows all about volatile. In the opening round, the Aussie went eagle-double bogey and then later birdie-double bogey on his front nine. He managed to rally with three straight birdies to open with a 69. It was a much cleaner card Friday.“I was disappointed in yesterday’s two double bogeys on the back nine, so I wanted to play that nine a bit smarter and a bit better today, so I didn’t short-side myself as much as what I did yesterday,” he said. “And it seemed to work out quite well.”Hend also took advantage of playing in the morning, the first one out when the greens were pure and the wind had not arrived along the Gulf Coast of Florida.Cink was within one shot of the lead until a bogey on his last hole. He was a young dissident challenging Moscow, a symbol of hope for a country emerging from decades of authoritarian rule.Fast forward to 2026, and the narrative has shifted dramatically. As Hungary approaches the results of its parliamentary elections today, Orban, who once said “Nyet” to Moscow, now cultivates ties with Vladimir Putin and has transformed Hungary into a gateway for foreign meddling.What prompted Orban’s dramatic trajectory from outspoken dissident to Putin puppet? For the first few decades of his political career, Orban was no ally of Russia. During his first time in office, he ushered Hungary into Nato, which constituted an open affront to Putin. It was only upon regaining power in 2010 that Orban abruptly changed his tune on Russia. This meant opening up diplomatically and economically to the East. At the same time, domestic reforms intended to consolidate his hold on power encouraged Orban to move closer to Russia.Energy remains Moscow’s most immediate lever of influence in Budapest, with Orban emphasising how “the foundation of Hungary’s energy security has been and continues to be Russian energy supplies”.Hungary remains one of the last European importers of Russian crude, through the Druzhba Pipeline running through Ukraine. Almost immediately after returning to power in 2010 with a supermajority, his party Fidesz rewrote the constitution. Laws impacting the media and NGOs are troubling, and Hungary has passed its own version of the “foreign agent” law.Like Putin, Orban presents himself as a champion of “traditional values” and Christian civilisation, and portraying Hungary as a bulwark against liberal Western culture. Due to Russia’s history of using humanitarian passageways as offensive traps, Kyiv rejected Putin’s offer. The result was a brutal massacre of almost 400 Ukrainian soldiers.This is the context in which we should see the Orthodox Easter ceasefire in Ukraine announced by Putin. The Kremlin has decreed that Russian forces cease hostilities from 4pm on Saturday to end-of-day on Sunday. extractedText: The Bride of ChristDecember 7, 2013 Share Messenger Post Whatsapp Email Copy Print 0:00 0:00 100“And one of the seven angels who had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues came to me and talked with me, saying, Come here, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.” Revelation 21:9 What is the deep desire of a father? To see his son married! The wedding of Jesus the only begotten son of God was in the mind of his Father from eternity. This awesome dad of Jesus is obsessed with the idea of getting his son married! He has been thinking about it over and over, this glorious wedding was rolling like a tape in his mind and imagination! The wedding planners and organizations of our days are countless and they do their best to arrange weddings according to each couple’s budget. But if there is one in the universe who really knows how to plan for a wedding it is the heavenly FATHER, he is the expert and there is none like him! Abraham sent his faithful servant to look for a bride to his son Isaac and made him swear not to return empty hands because he so longed to see his son married and he found him one, Rebekah! The other spiritual facet of this story points to the heavenly Father who sent his faithful Holy Spirit to search for a Bride for his son Jesus and he found him one, YOU! “The king’s daughter is all glorious within; her clothing is trimmed with gold. She shall be brought to the king in clothing of needlework; the virgins, her companions after her, shall be brought to you. They shall be led with joy and gladness; they shall enter into the King’s palace.” Psalms 45:13-15. Oh, how beautiful the bride of the lamb is (Song of Solomon 4:7), how beautiful and holy the perfecting of the saints that the Lord is doing in our hearts preparing us for the wedding! Read in Ezekiel 16: 7-14 God’s heart toward his wife, toward you, it will stir your heart with so much passion and love and will connect you to the heart beat of your heavenly groom: “I helped you to thrive like a plant in the field. You grew up and became a beautiful jewel. Your breasts became full, and your body hair grew, but you were still naked. And when I passed by again, I saw that you were old enough for love. So I wrapped my cloak around you to cover your nakedness and declared my marriage vows. I made a covenant with you, says the Sovereign LORD, and you became mine. “Then I bathed you and washed off your blood, and I rubbed fragrant oils into your skin. I gave you expensive clothing of fine linen and silk, beautifully embroidered, and sandals made of fine goatskin leather. I gave you lovely jewelry, bracelets, beautiful necklaces, a ring for your nose, earrings for your ears, and a lovely crown for your head. And so you were adorned with gold and silver. Your clothes were made of fine linen and were beautifully embroidered. You ate the finest foods—choice flour, honey, and olive oil—and became more beautiful than ever. You looked like a queen, and so you were! Your fame soon spread throughout the world because of your beauty. I dressed you in my splendor and perfected your beauty, says the Sovereign LORD.” Jesus loves his church in a way we can’t fathom, you can just foretaste a little bit of his extravagant love for you through the revealed word of God. Song of Solomon is such a concentrated love letter between Jesus and his church. The time is approaching, the wedding preparations are coming to an end, and the church is getting ready to be raptured after being captured by his love … Jesus is coming soon! P.S: Don’t be among the attendants, become his bride! Receive Jesus now in your heart!❤️‍ Would love your thoughts on my post! # Rapport RSE

## Engagé pour un impact durable

Être une entreprise responsable aujourd’hui, ce n’est plus afficher une trajectoire parfaite, mais assumer les défis, mesurer les écarts et progresser avec exigence vers une performance plus solide et plus responsable à long terme. Notre rapport RSE, publié en 2026, présente notre trajectoire, nos engagements et les progrès accomplis.

# La transformation durable ne se décrète pas, elle se met en œuvre

Notre **stratégie RSE** repose sur deux engagements forts :

![](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)

### Notre impact en chiffres

![](/content/dam/assets-zone2/fr/fr/img/icons/svg/green-2/woman-man.svg)

de femmes dans nos effectifs

![](/content/dam/assets-zone2/fr/fr/img/icons/svg/green-2/earth-green.svg)

collaborateurs et collaboratrices sensibilisés aux enjeux climatiques

![](/content/dam/assets-zone2/fr/fr/img/icons/svg/green-2/give-help-green.svg)

heures d'engagement par les collaborateurs dans les actions solidaires

### Être exemplaire dans toutes nos actions

#### Nous donnons vie à nos engagements RSE en transformant nos pratiques internes et nos actions auprès de nos clients. Nous avons lancé un programme interne appelé « We move » qui s’articule autour de 4 objectifs :

#### Agir pour la réussite et l'épanouissement de nos Talents

Accélérer les carrières de nos Talents, engager tous nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, et protéger le bien-être et la santé mentale.

### Agir pour la réussite et l'épanouissement de nos Talents

Notre ambition est simple : permettre à chacun de trouver sa place, de progresser et de s’inscrire dans la durée.  
Mais cette ambition se confronte à une réalité exigeante : nos métiers impliquent un haut niveau d’engagement, de pression et de responsabilité. Créer un environnement de travail durable, ce n’est donc pas seulement proposer des dispositifs. C’est agir concrètement sur les conditions de travail, la santé mentale, l’équilibre des vies et les perspectives de développement. Nous avons renforcé nos actions sur : la prévention des risques psychosociaux, l’accompagnement des moments de vie (parentalité, situations personnelles), et le développement des compétences à chaque étape de carrière. Notre objectif n’est pas uniquement d’attirer des talents. Il est de leur permettre de construire une trajectoire professionnelle qui reste soutenable dans le temps.

### Contribuer collectivement à un impact environnemental durable

Chez Deloitte, notre priorité est de réduire nos émissions de gaz à effet de serre (GES) de manière durable et mesurable.
